# biznetgio_object_storage_bucket (Resource)

Bucket inside an Object Storage instance. Only the ACL is mutable; the name is immutable.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "biznetgio_object_storage_bucket" "example" {
  account_id = biznetgio_object_storage.example.id
  name       = "my-app-assets"
  acl        = "private"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Object Storage instance account id.
- `name` (String) Bucket name, minimum 3 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9-_]`. Immutable.

### Optional

- `acl` (String) S3-style canned ACL: empty (default private), private, public-read, public-read-write, authenticated-read, log-delivery-write.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `<account_id>:<bucket_name>`.
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON of the last read from the API, for anything not modeled yet.
